US-6430053-B1,Pluggable transceiver module having rotatable release and removal lever with living hinge,"A pluggable transceiver module configured for insertion and extraction from a host receptacle, the module comprising:

wherein the lever includes a living hinge integrally formed with a body of the lever, the living hinge establishing a pivot axis for pivoting of the lever relative to the module housing.",refine

US-6663803-B1,Fabrication of a fractally attributively delamination resistive composite structure,"A method for fabricating a composite structure with fractal attributes that confer delamination resistance, the method comprising:

stacking the plurality of layers, incorporating said at least one interface having fractal geometry
consolidating the stacked layers to yield an integrated composite structure
wherein the fractal geometry of the at least one interface imparts fractal characteristics to the integrated composite structure, thereby enhancing its delamination resistance.",refine

US-6174448-B1,Method for stripping aluminum from a diffusion coating,"A method for stripping aluminum from a diffusion coating, comprising:

US-7828399-B1,Universal locker system,"A comprehensive locker system, including:

US-6228708-B1,Method of manufacturing high voltage mixed-mode device,"A method of fabricating a high voltage mixed-mode device, the method comprising:
obtaining a semiconductor substrate
forming a plurality of low voltage (LV) active regions and a plurality of high voltage (HV) active regions on the semiconductor substrate
selectively forming a first gate dielectric layer having a first thickness over the LV active regions
selectively forming a second gate dielectric layer having a second thickness, greater than said first thickness, over the HV active regions
forming gate electrodes over the first and second gate dielectric layers
forming LV source/drain regions within the LV active regions, said LV source/drain regions having a first junction depth and a first doping concentration profile

forming HV source/drain regions within the HV active regions, said HV source/drain regions having a second junction depth and a second doping concentration profile, wherein said second junction depth exceeds said first junction depth and said second doping concentration profile incorporates a drift region adapted for high voltage operation
forming isolation structures between certain of the LV active regions and the HV active regions

forming conductive interconnects electrically coupled to the LV source/drain regions, the HV source/drain regions, and the gate electrodes, thereby completing the high voltage mixed-mode device.",refine
